summary: Iteration 9 validation: seed pending payout, IBAN regex, refactored /admin/cruscotto router, and PDF export. Backend pytest: 10/10 passed. Frontend Playwright: /admin renders all 7 legacy data-testids + alert-iban-mancante + btn-export-pdf (href correct). Seed idempotency confirmed by restart: pending count stays at 1 (€45.50 for Giulia Marchetti). Refactored endpoint returns identical schema. IBAN regex: BADIBAN→422, mixed-case+spaces normalizes to uppercase-stripped, empty string clears field, valid 27-char IT99… accepted. PDF returns 200 with Content-Type application/pdf, body starts with %PDF-, and Content-Disposition contains cruscotto-YYYY-MM.pdf. Non-admin (patient) and unauth requests return 401/403 on both /cruscotto and /cruscotto/report.pdf. iter8 chart-visibility concern resolved: Aug bar renders full-height in the screenshot.

minor.issue: Response items still expose MongoDB '_id' field (should be renamed/removed per guidelines). Pre-existing across iterations; not introduced by this change.

action_items: Nit: review request example IBAN 'IT99999999999999999999999999' has 28 chars (2 extra). Correct 27-char test data used in the pytest suite; either fix the review-request wording or accept 28-char IBANs — current behaviour (reject 28-char) is correct per Italian IBAN spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: cruscotto endpoint successfully extracted to routers/admin_analytics.py with build_router factory; N+1 lookups replaced with $in via _batch_lookup_therapists — solid refactor.

cruscotto_pdf.py: max(values) called without values-empty guard; if revenue_6m is [] this raises. Guard already exists via `if max(values)>0` but max([]) itself throws — pass an initial `default=0` or check `values` first.
server.py still >2500 lines. Continue extracting domain routers (payments, terapisti, appuntamenti) to keep files <700 lines.

Seed pending-payout uses `demo_terapista.get('prezzo_sessione', 65.0)` — Giulia's therapist doc uses field 'prezzo_sessione' correctly in the seed loop; fine, but hard-coded fallback should log a warning if key missing.

IBAN validator runs on `mode='before'` and mutates input; combined with Optional[str]=None it means partial PUTs with unrelated fields bypass validation (only if 'iban' key present is it checked). Confirmed OK.
PDF endpoint uses `inline` Content-Disposition — browser will open the PDF instead of downloading. Consider `attachment;` if the 'Esporta PDF' UX is intended as download.
test_credentials: admin@funzionabene.it / admin2026 and demo.paziente@funzionabene.it / paziente2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Auth is cookie/session-based — requests.Session works.
seed_data_creation: None new. Boot-time seed_data() inserts one demo pending payment_transaction (Giulia Marchetti, €65 gross / €45.50 therapist_amount, payout_status=pending, _seed=true). Idempotent: only inserted when no existing payment_transaction has payment_status=paid AND payout_status!=paid. Confirmed by restarting backend twice — count stays at 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 fully validated. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py (10 tests, ~2s). For future iterations, note that Italian IBAN is 27 chars total (IT + 25 alnum), regex ^IT\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{23}$ correctly enforces this. Boot-time seed idempotency is critical — do not accidentally delete the `has_pending` guard.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. One minor spec typo in the review request (IBAN example had 28 chars); test suite uses correct 27-char valid IBAN.
